Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Two items we need clarified before we finalize internal approval:

1) Will Redwood issue a single PO number for the initial contract, or do you need separate POs per SKU/region? Our procurement system requires discrete PO lines when spend caps differ by line.
2) We want to cap spend to $125,000 in Q2 — can you confirm how spend cap will be represented on the PO and whether you support an umbrella cap with per-line ceilings?

I've attached our standard onboarding form; we'll return it signed after the PO is issued. Also, our legal asked whether PO numbers can be applied to future amendments without creating a new PO for every add-on.

Appreciate the help — we need to get this into our May board packet.

Best,

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks — this is straightforward, and we can accommodate both models but we need to align with Finance for the exact PO presentation. Quick answers up front:

- We can issue a single umbrella PO with line-item ceilings, or distinct PO numbers per SKU.
- Umbrella PO: we'll show the overall spend cap as a comment on the PO and enforce per-line ceilings on our invoicing/payment side.
- Amendments: we can reference the original PO number for add-ons (no new PO required) if both parties agree in the amendment language.

I'll loop in Marcus (Finance) and Laura (onboarding) to get a definitive PO number and confirm the exact line structure we should use for your procurement system. Can you confirm the SKUs you expect to appear on the PO and whether any items are tax-exempt? That will help Marcus with the spend cap mapping.

I'll attach our completed onboarding checklist for your review.
